EQUATION:
odeType = stiff

; Depot compartment (oral absorption)
depot(target = Ad, Tlag = Tlag)
ddt_Ad = -ka * Ad

; Central compartment
ddt_Ac = ka * Ad - Vm * Ac/V / (Km + Ac/V) - k12*Ac + k21*Ap

; Peripheral compartment
ddt_Ap = k12*Ac - k21*Ap

; Concentration in central compartment
Cc = Ac/V
